Q00106_ForgottenTruth/30358-01.htm.text: Tetrarch Thifiell: Curious foreign traveler, I have no favor to ask of you. As a rule, our race of darkness prefers not to receive the aid of others. (Quest for Dark Elven characters.)

Q00106_ForgottenTruth/30358-06.html.text: Tetrarch Thifiell: What are you doing, you haven't gone to the temple yet?! Go immediately to the Temple of Shillien and seek Kartia. Give him the onyx talisman and return to me with the translated revelations.

Q00106_ForgottenTruth/30358-07.html.text: Tetrarch Thifiell: Well done! I was just getting anxious that you were not returning ... So, is this the Kaisha's revelation that Kartia has translated? This ancient writing contains the dark inheritance passed on to our race, the truths that have been until now hidden by the Elves of Light and the…

Q00217_TestimonyOfTrust/30358-04.html.text: Tetrarch Thifiell I will keep a close eye on the Humans' behavior. I pray that our trust will grow. Now return to your King.

Q00217_TestimonyOfTrust/30358-05.html.text: Tetrarch Thifiell Why are you still here? Have you met Magister Clayton from the Town of Dion ? Have you come to improve relations between our races or is there something else on your mind?

Q00219_TestimonyOfFate/30358-01.html.text: Tetrarch Thifiell: Welcome home, young brother. It seems like only yesterday when you came here after you finished training in the shrine of Shilen. My, haven't you grown! This document you have found is known as 'Kaysha's Revelation'. It contains the truth about Shilen! It contains the truth of th…

Q00219_TestimonyOfFate/30358-02.html.text: Tetrarch Thifiell: It is time for you to take the Initiation Ceremony of Shilen. Take the letter and charm that I gave you to Witch Arkenia of the Dark Elves Initiation Altar . She will perform your ceremony.
when: state STARTED; has items 3190,3191; lacks items 3189

Q00219_TestimonyOfFate/30358-03.html.text: Tetrarch Thifiell: The Book of the Abyss is the living history of our past and future. It is where all our tribal knowledge and experience is recorded. To complete the Initiation Ceremony you must write your own phrase in the book. Good luck!
when: state STARTED; has items 3190,3192; lacks items 3189,3191
